| `object` | `object`  | ✓        | —       | The row's object.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `layout` | `object`  | ✓        | —       | What the row draws: `{ title, badge?: { when, label }, description?, chips?: { field, each, tones? }, meta?: Array&lt;string&gt;, table?: { field, columns, note?, action?: { id, label } }, buttons?: Array&lt;{ action, label?, icon? }&gt; }`. A button's `icon` is a CnIcon name drawn before its label. A table column is `{ key?, label, as?, template?, strong?, text?, tones? }`, `as` one of `text` (default), `order`, `bar`, `check`, `yesNo`, `pill`. `table.sortable` / `table.filterable` put a sort button and a filter button on every column header (a column's own `sortable` / `filterable: false` opts it out). `table.reorder: { key? }` draws a drag handle per entry; a move emits `reorder` with the list renumbered in `key` (default `order`). |
| `open`   | `boolean` |          | `false` | Whether the row starts open.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
